prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original grounded medieval RPG LOW RES PIXEL ART location review concept, elevated three-quarter cutaway. Chunky hard square pixel clusters, selective dark outlines, restrained three-tone stone timber linen iron, muted earth palette, no smooth painting or photorealism. No people, no readable text, no quest UI, no magic, no claimed outcome. Modest practical scale, no giant fantasy architecture. Open ordinary return path clearly visible. Geometry is a proposal, not certified collision or inventory. One small shore-side ferry waiting pavilion built on continuous dry mainland. Bench, one uncollected tied travel bundle under bench, plain wooden departure tally board without letters. A dry broad cart track curves behind pavilion back inland. Separate side gangway to water has a closed low gate; no boat and no person in water. Pavilion is NOT an island and mainland road remains fully open. No chapel, forced religious ritual, arrival, free infinite transport or safe-capacity certification. Focus resting and land return when ferry side closes.
